sources.snippet: # ねぎし 銀座並木通り店. Do you recommend this business? ## Location & Hours. ## Amenities and More. ## Recommended Reviews. Your trust is our priority, so businesses can't pay to alter or remove their reviews. With so few reviews, your opinion of ねぎし 銀座並木通り店 could be huge. I believe this is a chain restaurant. But the experience was still great. Great wait staff and very efficient service. We waited approximately 10 mins before getting seated on a Saturday around 8pm. The lady took our order right before we sat down and the food was served in 5 minutes. Great place if you enjoy beef tongue! See all photos from James L.
